method: Uploaded blob identities compared with local Git SHA-1; committed R16 subtree recursively fetched and every selected path, blob SHA and size independently compared with the final local manifest. The manifest itself is also included in this comparison.
acceptance: Publication integrity only; seven research blockers remain open; no full-workspace CI or production acceptance.
self_reference: This attestation is added after the audited evidence commit and is therefore not included in its own checked-files count.
